title: OpenNoodl Component Connections
description: Connection (wire) definitions for a single component (connections.json) in the v2 format

componentId.description: ID of the parent component — must match component.json id

connections.description: All connections (wires) in this component's graph

fromProperty.description: Output port name on the source node

toProperty.description: Input port name on the target node

label.description: Author-written text shown on the wire (CAN-002)

labelT.description: Where the label sits along the wire, 0..1 (CAN-001)

anchors.description: Hand-drawn routing (SIG-007). Each anchor is read in the wire's own chord frame — u along it (0..1, dimensionless), v across it in graph px — so the routing stretches with the wire when a node moves instead of pinning it to the canvas. Absent when there is none; never an empty array.

u.description: Position along the chord, 0 at the source and 1 at the target

v.description: Offset across the chord, in graph px
